column1: # s1e.tsv -- the mutations base#1465 (config-gen S1e, manifest admission
# and the coverage ratchet) requires script/test/mutation-probe.sh to
# report PINNED. One row per shell guard: each constructor guard of
# config_gen_mutation_lang.sh, each list, manifest and path-state rule of
# config_gen_admit.sh, the runner's event re-emission, step-output routing
# and cache filter, each 05-floors-base refusal, the coverage gate's usage
# guard, and the redpath's verdicts on the refusal, stale, rerun, green and
# coverage cases, its per-test case scope and locale case, and each guard of the
# Dockerfile's admit RUN, whose own text config_gen_gates_spec runs outside
# a build. The ratchet's rules are pinned by its Go table.
# <id> TAB <subject> TAB <spec> TAB <old> TAB <new> TAB <witness>, the contract of
# once in <subject> and is replaced by <new> (empty <new> deletes), both
# written with the three escapes \\ \t \n. `just test mutation-required`
# probes every row and passes only when each one is PINNED.
